articleTitle: Why Your Front Splits Routine Needs More Than Hamstring Work
imageHeadline: Your Front Split Is Stuck? Check Your Hip Flexors
imageSubtext: Hamstring stretches alone won't get you there—here's what's missing
pinTitle: Why Front Splits Need Hip Flexor Work (Not Just Hamstring Stretches)
pinDescription: Most front split routines focus only on hamstrings, but hip flexor mobility is just as critical for progress. Learn how to structure a balanced flexibility routine that addresses both muscle groups for real results.
